name: Vincent
source:
A business finance freshman at University of Storm Hill. [url=https://vndb.org/c52039]Maxine's[/url] best friend since high school. Tends to be a little childish at times but mostly reliable. Loves learning new skate-board tricks. The "Bro" among friends. Loves coconut-flavored food. Maxine thinks he needs to get his tastebuds checked out. Also known as "Mr. Yuri fanboy," a quote from Maxine.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=38465]official thread[/url]]
